method: Reviewed the official City Legistar matter record, its City Council agenda history, and every official attachment. Downloaded and extracted each original, compared SHA-256 values, and visually inspected the signed enactment pages.

attachments.reason: Exact SHA-256 match to the existing validated archive; visual review confirms the signed C/S R-21-128 enactment adopted March 15, 2021.

result: No new archive or site placement is warranted. The existing canonical enacted-resolution archive retains the final project budget, while both predecessor versions are documented as superseded.
